title: Invoice numbers should restart every year
prompt: Our accountants want invoice numbers in the form `INV-<year>-<sequence>`, with the sequence starting again at 0001 every January 1st. For example INV-2026-0001 and INV-2026-0002, followed by INV-2027-0001 in the new year. The year is the year the invoice is issued, in UTC. Invoice ids are unaffected.
